title: Göbekli Tepe built and buried by survivors of a cataclysm

tellings.quote: Gobeclete in Turkey where we attributed that area to just hunter gatherers then lo and behold this you know incredible ancient the oldest megalithic temple site pops up out of the ground

plain: On a show hosted by a podcaster named Jesse Michels, a researcher named Jay Anderson talks about Göbekli Tepe, a site in Turkey that he calls the oldest temple of huge standing stones. He says experts thought only simple hunter-gatherers lived in that area, and then this remarkable temple came up out of the ground, which he takes as a sign it was built, and later buried, by people who survived some ancient disaster.
